Less matchday  guesswork.  A simple guide to your first badminton match on SportStage.
First, choose  your players.  Pick the players for each side before you start.
Make it  your match.  Review the format and scoring rules before the first serve.
Ready to play?  Start scoring.  Review the match, then tap the rally winner to score.
Wrong tap?  Undo the rally.  Use “Undo last rally” to correct the latest scoring entry.
Your next match.  Your stage.  Save the playbook. Share it with your scorekeeper.
